description: A React component for exploring and displaying available tools of an MCP server with search, expand/collapse, and detailed parameter schema views.

methods.name: formatSchema
methods.description: Formats a schema object into a JSON string with indentation for display.

methods.name: getSchemaProperties
methods.description: Extracts parameter properties from a schema, including name, type, description, required flag, default value, and enum options.

methods.name: renderToolCard
methods.description: Renders a collapsible card UI component for a given tool, displaying description, parameters, and input schema.
